grammar.summary: 本课学习表"迎接/纪念"的被动与 celebration 场景。

points.title: 被动叙事（节日由来）
points.explanation: The festival is held every year. / lanterns are lit 被动贯穿民俗描述："仪式被执行"的客观视角。

examples.en: The festival is celebrated all over Japan.
examples.cn: 全日本都庆祝这个节日。

points.title: so that 目的从句复现（收尾）
points.explanation: so that they can guide the spirits home. 全册最后重温目的状语从句。

examples.en: They are lit so that the spirits can find their way home.
examples.cn: 点燃它们是为了让亡灵找到回家的路。
